name: npm-intellisense
description: Visual Studio Code plugin that autocompletes npm modules in import statements
readme:
# npm Intellisense

Completes module names from your package.json inside `require("` and `import ... from "`. The Import module command picks a module from a list and inserts an import statement at the cursor. Set `npm-intellisense.scanDevDependencies` to include devDependencies. The extension starts only when a folder is open, the same as in VS Code.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.

works: Module names from package.json in require and import completions, next to the built-in TypeScript ones
The Import module command: a quick pick of modules, the statement goes in at the cursor
devDependencies through npm-intellisense.scanDevDependencies; an empty list without a package.json
